text: Users of the Early Learning Centre at 17 High Park Avenue expressed concerns about vehicles that remain in the pick-up / drop-off spot in the mornings. Transportation staff have provided the below recommendations.

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing maximum 15 minute parking regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the east side of High Park Avenue from a point 51 metres north of Bloor Street West and a point 21 metres further north to be in effect from 7:15 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. 2. City Council prohibit parking from 7:00 a.m. to 7:15 a.m., Monday to Friday on the east side of High Park Avenue from a point 51 metres north of Bloor Street West and a point 21 metres further north.
